title: Unified hosted endpoints PRD — chat / completions / embeddings / rerank
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: Deliver a single, production-ready PRD that defines the API contract, runbook, acceptance criteria, and launch checklist for the hosted chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank endpoints. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, and Design work required to ship a cohesive hosted API surface that is backward-compatible where possible, observable, and ready for enterprise customers.

Context: Multiple incremental changes over the last two quarters led to divergent behaviors between chat and completions (streaming semantics, function calling edge cases) and fragmented telemetry for embeddings and rerank. Customers building multi-endpoint workflows (e.g., embed -> rerank -> generate) need consistent semantics and clear migration guidance.

This PRD focuses on the hosted API surface only; Dedicated and Private deployment edge cases will be handled in separate follow-up tickets but must be considered in acceptance criteria where applicable.
goals: Unify request/response semantics across chat and completions (streaming, stop sequences, role handling)
Define stable embedding size and normalization expectations and guarantee reference cosine compatibility
Deliver a deterministic rerank endpoint contract that returns stable scores and ordering with documentation on tie-breaking
Provide a launch checklist that covers perf SLOs, security review, SDK updates, docs, and migration guides
Minimize customer breaking changes; provide compatibility shims or opt-in toggles where necessary
success_metrics: Latency: p50/p95 for chat and completions within agreed SLOs (p95 < 450ms for short prompts under hosted-tier constraints)
Error rate: <0.5% 5xx for the first two weeks post-launch across all endpoints
Adoption: at least 30 newly onboarded customers use the unified endpoints for multi-step workflows within one month
Docs & SDK coverage: official SDKs updated and published with code samples for each endpoint before GA
Regression tests: zero regressions in model quality tests (as measured by PRM prompt sets) post-rollout
in_scope: Final API contract for hosted chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank endpoints
Streaming and non-streaming semantics alignment for chat/completions
Embedding output metadata (dimension, model, vector normalization guidance)
Rerank scoring schema and stable ordering rules
Telemetry and dashboards: per-endpoint latency/cost/error breakdowns and token-level cost attribution
SDK docs and migration guide for API changes
Launch runbook and canary plan for staged rollout
out_of_scope: Dedicated capacity-specific autoscaling behaviors (tracked under ENG-4201)
On-prem packaging and air-gapped install flow (Private infra tickets will follow)
Model training or changes to model architectures
Billing model changes beyond per-token and embedding unit accounting
api_changes: chat: standardize message role semantics (user/system/assistant) and ensure 'function_call' behaviors match documented sequence when streaming is enabled
completions: support same stop sequence behavior as chat and expose 'finish_reason' consistently between endpoints
embeddings: guarantee output vector length and include a stable 'model_version' field in response metadata; add optional 'normalize=true' flag that returns L2-normalized vectors
rerank: accept a list of candidate documents + query and return a ranked list with scores; define score range (0-1) and tie-breaking rules based on candidate insertion order
errors: unify error codes and messages across endpoints (e.g., RATE_LIMITED, MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE, INVALID_INPUT) and document recommended retry semantics
headers & tracing: enforce X-Request-Id and support optional traceparent for distributed tracing
compatibility_migrations: Compatibility shim: if client omits 'role' in chat messages, server will infer 'user' for backwards compatibility for 90 days
Deprecated behavior: legacy 'completion_style' parameter will be honored but will emit a deprecation warning header; provide migration examples in docs
Embeddings normalization: default remains unnormalized for now; recommend opt-in 'normalize=true' to avoid silent changes in customer similarity scores
telemetry_and_observability: Add per-route token-level cost breakdown to Console (token_in, token_out, compute_cost_estimate)
Instrument end-to-end latency P50/P95/P99 per model and per request-size bucket
Alerting: setup SLO burn-rate alerts and a pager escalation path for p95 > target for more than 15 minutes
Log enrichment: include model_version, route, customer_id (hashed), and request_size in structured logs
Create a lightweight smoke test that runs against canary instances every 5 minutes and reports on Quality Regression Monitor (PRM) prompts
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Branch stabilization & API contract validation (unit/contract tests) — ENG owns
Phase 1: Internal dogfood with SDKs and Console integration for 2 weeks — invite core platform teams
Phase 2: Canary release to 5% of traffic with feature flag gating and increased telemetry retention
Phase 3: Ramp to 25% for 48 hours, validate metrics and error rates
Phase 4: Full rollout with coordinated SDK release notes and migration guide
Fallback: automated rollback to previous compatible API variant if error rate > 1% sustained for 30 minutes
acceptance_criteria: API contract: OpenAPI/JSON schema published and validated by contract tests (no schema diffs on critical fields)
E2E tests: smoke and integration tests passing against canary environment (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank)
Performance: latency targets met for defined buckets and perf regression < 5% compared to baseline
SDKs: official JS/Python SDKs updated and example snippets exercised in CI
Docs: migration guide, examples, and deprecation notices published in Docs and included in release notes
Telemetry: dashboards present with token cost breakdown and SLO alerts configured
Security: threat model reviewed and security signoff obtained from SEC team
Runbook: on-call runbook and incident playbooks available and reviewed by SRE
Customer comms: prepared email/postmortem template and FAQ for known incompatibilities
launch_checklist: Finalize and commit API schema; tag release 'hosted-api-2026.04'
Merge contract tests and ensure green CI for all SDKs
Publish SDK versions and update package registries (npm, PyPI)
Publish docs, migration guide, and quickstart samples
Create Console dashboards and verify token cost telemetry displays correctly
Complete security review and compliance checklist (SOC2 artifacts updated, if applicable)
Schedule internal announcement and customer blog + support knowledge base article
Enable canary flag and start Phase 2 canary with monitoring observers on-call
Validate smoke test runs and PRM prompt results for 48 hours
Signoff call with Eng, SRE, SEC, Docs, and SDK owners before full ramp
risks: Breaking customer integrations if role/streaming semantics change unexpectedly
Embeddings normalization change could shift similarity scores and surface false negatives for customers; mitigated by opt-in normalization flag
Rerank score instability across model versions leading to unexpected ordering; need stable scoring documentation and test harness
Undiscovered perf regressions at scale due to new telemetry hooks or schema validation overhead
notes: Decision log: prefer opt-in behavior for any change that can affect numeric outputs (e.g., embedding normalization).
Trade-off: stricter contract validation increases safety but may add CPU overhead; will run A/B to measure cost impact in canary.
Design feedback: DES-227 proposes a single combined docs page with interactive examples — agreed as part of launch docs scope.
Follow-ups: schedule post-launch quality retrospective and a task to evaluate Dedicated/Private parity for these API changes
